# JAPAN RAIL PASS

> > Official guide to the JAPAN RAIL PASS by JR Group, covering purchase, usage, and travel across Japan's extensive rail network including Shinkansen lines.

This site provides comprehensive information about the JAPAN RAIL PASS, a special train ticket for foreign visitors covering JR trains nationwide. It includes details on purchasing passes online, using them at ticket gates and stations, making seat reservations, and navigating Japan's rail system including the Tokaido, Sanyo, and other Shinkansen lines.

## Key Topics

- JAPAN RAIL PASS
- JR Group
- Shinkansen travel
- NOZOMI and MIZUHO trains
- Reserved seat booking
- Online purchase and reservation
- Tokaido Shinkansen
- Sanyo Shinkansen
- Automatic ticket gates
- Train pass pricing
- JR stations (Tokyo, Shin-Osaka)
- Regional coverage (Hokkaido, Kyushu)
- Seat reservation system
- Rail travel in Japan

## Getting Started

- [ジャパン・レール・パス | JAPAN RAIL PASS](https://japanrailpass.net/): Homepage for JAPAN RAIL PASS by JR Group with pricing and booking info
- [Purchase online | JAPAN RAIL PASS](https://japanrailpass.net/en/purchase/online/): Online purchase process for JAPAN RAIL PASS with seat reservation option

## Using Your Pass

- [Traveling with a JAPAN RAIL PASS | JAPAN RAIL PASS](https://japanrailpass.net/en/use/): Guide to using JAPAN RAIL PASS for train travel and seat reservations
- [Automatic ticket gates | JAPAN RAIL PASS](https://japanrailpass.net/en/use/automatic-ticket-gate/): Instructions for using JAPAN RAIL PASS at automatic ticket gates

## Travel Planning

- [Travel Tips | ジャパン・レール・パス | JAPAN RAIL PASS](https://japanrailpass.net/travel-tips/): Travel tips for JR stations, WiFi, lockers, holidays, and rush hours
